project_type: React + TypeScript + Vite + Tailwind CSS + Recharts frontend application
verification_instructions: 1. Run `npm test` to ensure all unit tests pass. 2. Run `npm run build` to verify build succeeds. 3. Run `npm run dev` and manually test critical flows.
snapshot_or_generated_files: dist/ directory generated by build; no generated files checked in
environment_constraints: Node.js 18+ required; development server runs on port 5173; project uses npm (not yarn or pnpm)
contribution_requirements: No specific CONTRIBUTING.md found; follow existing patterns in codebase.
key_patterns: 1. Components use Tailwind CSS with navy (#0f2744) and sage (#2d7d46) color scheme. 2. Utility functions are in src/utils/. 3. Tariff data in src/data/tariffs.ts. 4. Tests use Vitest syntax with describe/it/expect. 5. Components follow functional component pattern with TypeScript interfaces.
directory_structure: src/ - source code; src/components/ - React components; src/data/ - tariff data; src/utils/ - utility functions; src/test/ - test setup; public/ - static assets
